name: lif-workflow
description: Cross-repository workflow for LIF coding agents: session handoff (handoff, pickup, plan-handoff), planning and backlog (structured-planning, backlog, seed), single-issue and PR loops (issue-implement, issue-review, pr-shepherd), idea-to-PR subagent pipeline with per-run learnings retro (shipit, retro), software factory that takes one feature through spec, build, review lenses, a second-model review, retro and an approver (factory), Codex fanout (codex), Herdr workspaces per repo (herdr-workspace), Apple HIG UI design and audit (ui-hig), prompt rewriting for Opus 5.5 (prompt-optimize), layered ASD-STE100 explanations (explain), Claude Code reference (claude-code-docs, claude-code-reviewer), vault conventions (obsidian-vault), skill authoring (skill-designer), personal utilities (morning-briefing, markdown-to-docx, wechat-auto), and PreToolUse/PostToolUse safety and formatting hooks.
